title: Accrual
description: Accrual entity representing daily interest computation for a loan as-of a specific date. This is the single source of truth for accrual data, with embedded journal entries that follow an inheritance contract.

loanId.description: Reference to the loan for which this accrual is calculated

asOfDate.description: Business date for which this accrual is calculated. Also serves as the effective date for all journal entries

currency.description: Currency for all amounts in this accrual (ISO-4217 code)

aprId.description: Reference to the APR (Annual Percentage Rate) used for calculation

dayCountConvention.description: Day count convention used for interest calculation (ACT_360, ACT_365, THIRTY_360)

dayCountFraction.description: Calculated day count fraction (e.g., 1/360 for ACT_360)

interestAmount.description: Calculated interest amount for the day. Formula: principalSnapshot.amount × APR × dayCountFraction

postingTimestamp.description: Timestamp when the accrual was posted to the subledger

priorPeriodFlag.description: Flag indicating if this is a prior-period adjustment (back-dated into closed GL month)

runId.description: Reference to the batch run that produced this accrual (optional)

version.description: Version number for this accrual (for optimistic locking)

supersedesAccrualId.description: Reference to the accrual being superseded (for rebook scenarios). When set, this accrual replaces a prior accrual for the same asOfDate

journalEntries.description: Embedded journal entries for this accrual. These entries inherit asOfDate, currency, loanId, postingTimestamp, priorPeriodFlag, and runId

PrincipalSnapshot.description: Snapshot of the loan's principal balance used for accrual calculation

amount.description: The principal amount at the time of snapshot

effectiveAtStartOfDay.description: Whether this principal amount is effective at the start of the day (true) or end of day (false) for the asOfDate

JournalEntry.description: Embedded journal entry within an Accrual entity. Journal entries inherit asOfDate, currency, loanId, postingTimestamp, priorPeriodFlag, and runId from the parent Accrual

entryId.description: Unique identifier for this journal entry

account.description: General ledger account for this entry (INTEREST_RECEIVABLE, INTEREST_INCOME)

direction.description: Direction of the entry (DR or CR)

amount.description: Amount of the entry in the currency inherited from parent Accrual

kind.description: Kind of entry (ORIGINAL, REVERSAL, or REPLACEMENT)

adjustsEntryId.description: Reference to the entry being adjusted (required for REVERSAL entries). Points to the entryId of the original entry being reversed

code.description: Error code identifying the type of failure (e.g., INVALID_PRINCIPAL, MISSING_APR, CALCULATION_ERROR)

message.description: Human-readable error message describing the failure
